content_of_post_to_answer: How do you stay focused when your mind feels messy and overwhelmed?
answer: A messy mind is often not a focus problem but an unfinished-processing problem. Trying to force concentration while carrying too many open loops creates more resistance. I find it helps to first separate what needs action from what only needs acknowledgment. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. Focus is rarely created by pushing harder; it often appears when the mind no longer has to keep everything in memory.
